input.prompt: Anime key visual, cinematic widescreen film frame. Modern anime style matching the character sheets: crisp clean line art, flat cel shading, strong rim light, bold simple silhouettes, low background clutter, no text, no logos. Night rooftop under a sky dense with stars. Two versions of the same woman stand side by side about one meter apart, both facing the viewer and then turning toward each other: on the LEFT, Jade in 2011 (black bucket hat, white linen shirt, rust-red tiered skirt); on the RIGHT, Jade in 2026 (grey oversized hoodie, loose messy bun). Medium-wide shot from the knees up, both fully in frame with space above their heads, warm city glow far below.
